title: Barbell Rollout
summary: A kneeling rollout with a loaded barbell, the same as the ab wheel with a wider, steadier base.

muscles.why: Library rating 1 for abs (main mover): each working set adds 1 of a set to the weekly abs total.
Library rating 0.3 for lats (minor): each working set adds 0.3 of a set to the weekly lats total.
Library rating 0.2 for obliques: below the counting floor, so it adds nothing to the weekly obliques total.

setup.text: Kneel behind a barbell with small plates on it, hands on the bar.
Roll it forward, letting your body extend while your ribs stay down.
Pull it back using your abs.

form_cues.cue: Only go as far as you can without your lower back sagging.

lower_risk.text: Warm-up: the app adds no ramp-up sets; make the first working set a touch lighter if you like.
The app suggests a heavier load only when the jump is 10% or less; otherwise it adds a rep first.
Default target: 10-15 reps, stopping about 2 reps short of failure (RIR 2). Stop the set when form breaks down.
Use the same controlled range on every rep; lower under control rather than dropping or bouncing.
Set safety arms or pins where you can fail a rep safely, or use a spotter, and use collars.
Pick a variation and range you can train pain-free.

alternatives.goal_label: Home gym: no equipment / bar only
alternatives.why: Similar muscles; bodyweight instead of barbell.
Swap sheet: Better isolation, More stable.
